Ṣaḍdarśanasiddhāntasaṅgraha
Ṣaḍdarśanīsiddhāntasaṁgraha
bibl.note: A Descriptive Catalogue of the Sanskrit Manuscripts in the Tanjore Maharaja Serfoji’s Sarasvati Mahal Library, Tanjore (Tanjore). Vols. 1–19.
Lists of Sanskrit Manuscripts in Private Libraries of Southern India (Oppert). Vols 1–2.
Raghavan, Venkataraman. Śāhendravilāsa of Śrīdhara Veṅkaṭeśa (A Poem on the Life of King Śāhaji of Tanjore, 1684-1710). Tiruchi: The Kalyan Press, 1952.
Co-authored doxography covering six darśanas, namely Nyāya, Vaiśeṣika, Pūrvamīmāṃsā (both schools), Sāṃkhya (including the Seśvara system), Advaita Vedānta and grammar.
Seven co-authors. Aside from those mentioned in this record, there is also Yajñeśvarādhvarī and Śrīnivāsamakhī
